texts.zh:
对[From.GetName]的表面细致勘探后我们发现了一个巨大撞击坑，其中散步着一些来历不明的古代舰船残骸碎片。这些舰船中似乎完全没有装配生命支持系统，我们推测它们可能是一些巨型无人机或者由某种人工智能操控。

这些舰船的船体材料颇为有趣，是由活性金属这种极其稀有的无机材料构造而成。这种材料属性多样而独特，可以被“编码”成特定形状，在受到损伤时，能够缓慢地自我修复。数千年过去，舰船上的活性金属逐渐熔化，形成了巨大、致密的矿脉，可供我们采集数个世纪。
texts.en:
Detailed surface scans of [From.GetName] have identified a large impact crater containing the wreckage of several ancient starships of unknown design. The ships appear to be completely devoid of life support systems, leading us to suspect that they were either unusually large drones or controlled by some form of artificial intelligence.

Interestingly, the hull of the ships was constructed out of Living Metal, an exceedingly rare and inorganic material with many unique properties. This metal can be "programmed" to assume a certain shape or form, and it will slowly regrow itself if damaged. Over a period of several millennia, the surviving metal from the wrecked ships was fused into a large and extremely dense deposit that could potentially be mined for centuries to come.

summary.text:
# 奇特的撞击坑 / Peculiar Crater

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/00_anomaly_categories.txt:772; events/anomaly_events_2.txt:984 (anomaly.2576)

## 如何开始 How it starts

荒芜、寒冷荒芜星球或小行星可能生成（7级，基础权重0.1；has_any_strategic_resource = no；已有采矿或研究站矿藏时权重为0；should_ai_and_humans_use = yes）。

Can spawn on barren, cold barren planets or asteroids (level 7, base weight 0.1; requires no strategic resource; weight 0 if a mining or research station deposit exists; should_ai_and_humans_use = yes).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

单一结果 anomaly.2576“新的金属”：清除矿藏并设置 d_living_metal_deposit；若玩家已有 tech_mine_living_metal 选项则推进25%进度，否则添加该研究选项。

Single result anomaly.2576 "A New Metal": deposits cleared and d_living_metal_deposit set; if tech_mine_living_metal is already an option it gains 25% progress, otherwise the research option is added.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

唯一结果。

Single outcome.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无文明差异。

No empire differences.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对；编译树正确。该异常通向活金属科技，但该科技本身不属于本故事。

Checked; the compiled tree is correct. The anomaly leads to the living-metal technology, which is not itself part of this story.
